newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore power gas tariffs rise by 0.33 cent/kWh.
newsitem.headline: Singapore power gas tariffs rise by 0.33 cent/kWh.

text.p: Electricity tariffs in Singapore will increase by 0.33 cent per kilowatt hour (kWh) for the August 1-October 31 quarter, state utility Singapore Power said on Thursday.
The general tariffs for all units will be increased to 14.64 cents per kWh from 14.31 cents.

High tension tariffs during peak period (0700-2300 hours) would be raised to 9.14 from 8.81 cents per kWh, while charges during off peak period (2300-0700 hours) will rise to 8.14 cents from 7.81 cents.
